questions.question: Which punctuation mark is used at the end of a simple statement or command?

options.text: Question Mark (?)

questions.explanation: A full stop is used to mark the end of a declarative sentence (a statement) or an imperative sentence (a command).

questions.question: Choose the sentence with the correct punctuation for a possessive noun.
